description.zh: 固定偶模数，保留相位、重数和原平均分母；目标是截断交叉项的逐点单侧裕量。 二次幂子族还需检验单点信息的局限：尝试在保留固定周期质量的同时消去全部反射配对。
description.en: Keep phases, multiplicities and the original denominator. Seek a one-sided margin at each even modulus. For dyadic targets, test the limits of one-point information by preserving fixed periodic masses while removing all reflected pairs.
